title: Restore v55 frontend behavior and fix runtime backend canister configuration to unblock dashboard/admin/ordering

requirements.summary: Align the frontend workspace with Version 55 expectations and ensure the restored version builds cleanly.
acceptanceCriteria: The codebase reflects Version 55 as the active version (not Version 58).
A clean build completes for the restored Version 55 project.

file_operations.description: Update documentation to match the restored Version 55 build/deploy workflow and remove any references introduced after v55 that no longer apply.
Reconcile performance notes with the restored Version 55 behavior so the document matches the active codebase (no references to later-version-only changes).
Ensure the example env file reflects the restored Version 55 configuration behavior for build-time vs runtime canister ID resolution.

requirements.summary: Make backend canister ID resolution reliable in production via build-time env or runtime-config.json, and prevent routing to generic error pages when config is correctly set.
acceptanceCriteria: When VITE_BACKEND_CANISTER_ID is set to a valid principal at build time, navigating to Dashboard, Admin Panel, and placing an order works without showing the "Configuration Error" screen.
When VITE_BACKEND_CANISTER_ID is empty/missing, setting a valid principal in /runtime-config.json (deployed static site) allows the app to connect after a reload and the same flows work.
If the backend canister ID is missing/invalid, the app shows the dedicated configuration error screen with diagnostics (not a generic router error page).

file_operations.description: Harden runtime-config loading/validation: (1) treat empty build-time env as allowed when runtime config exists, (2) improve validation error classification and messaging for missing vs invalid IDs, and (3) expand diagnostics to clearly report whether /runtime-config.json was attempted/loaded and which source was selected.
Ensure connectivity state derivation correctly prioritizes validated configuration sources and does not mark the app as misconfigured when /runtime-config.json provides a valid canister ID.
Adjust retry behavior so unreachable/unhealthy states can re-attempt health checks and queries without forcing navigation to the router error boundary; keep misconfiguration non-retriable.

Ensure the gate always renders BackendConnectionErrorScreen for misconfigured/unreachable/unhealthy states and never allows those states to fall through into route rendering that could trigger the generic router error screen.

Add a fast-path that detects configuration misconfiguration via the runtime config utilities and renders the dedicated BackendConnectionErrorScreen (with diagnostics) instead of the generic router error UI when the underlying issue is missing/invalid canister configuration. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Relax production env assertions to allow static hosting mode: permit VITE_BACKEND_CANISTER_ID to be empty when the deployment is intended to supply /runtime-config.json at runtime, while still failing fast for malformed principals when a value is provided.

Clarify and align production configuration variables for both IC deployment (build-time VITE_BACKEND_CANISTER_ID) and static hosting (runtime-config.json), matching the actual runtime resolution logic.
Ensure the runtime config file format matches what runtimeConfig.ts expects and that it is suitable for deployed static hosting at /runtime-config.json (no repo-local path assumptions).

requirements.summary: Correct and improve user-facing configuration help text for static hosting vs IC deployment, with accurate file paths and actionable steps in English.
acceptanceCriteria: The configuration error screen’s "How to Fix" instructions reference the deployed runtime config file path ("/runtime-config.json" or "dist/runtime-config.json" depending on context) rather than source-repo paths like "frontend/public/runtime-config.json".
The instructions clearly distinguish IC deployment (build-time env) vs static hosting (runtime file) without requiring users to modify source code.

file_operations.description: Update the "How to Fix" copy to reference deployed paths (e.g., /runtime-config.json for static hosting, and dist/runtime-config.json when describing the build artifact), and clearly separate build-time env steps from runtime file steps. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Adjust missing/invalid configuration error messages so they are accurate for both IC deployment and static hosting (avoid telling users to edit source-repo files).
Update static hosting troubleshooting guidance to match the actual deployed workflow (editing /runtime-config.json on the hosted site, then reloading), and align terminology with the UI diagnostics.
Update comments/instructions to accurately describe when to use VITE_BACKEND_CANISTER_ID (IC deployment) vs /runtime-config.json (static hosting), in clear English.

requirements.summary: Verify and stabilize dashboard, admin panel, and checkout/order placement flows so they work end-to-end when configuration is set, with proper auth gating and non-generic failure handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can open /dashboard and see their orders load (or an empty state) without runtime configuration errors.
Authenticated users can complete the cart checkout/order placement flow without being redirected to an error page.
Admins can open /admin and load the admin panel without runtime configuration errors.
Backend health check and order APIs used by the frontend respond successfully when called with proper authentication and configuration.

file_operations.description: Confirm all authenticated routes involved in ordering (/dashboard, /orders/new, /orders/$orderId, /cart, /admin) are consistently wrapped with AuthGate + BackendGate (and AdminGate where applicable) so misconfiguration/unreachable states are handled by the dedicated screen rather than the router error boundary. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Improve checkout failure handling to ensure backend/authorization/configuration errors are surfaced via user-friendly toasts and do not trigger navigation into the router error boundary during order creation.

Harden order creation error handling so missing actor/config/auth failures are translated into actionable, user-friendly errors (and do not manifest as unhandled exceptions that lead to the generic error page).

Ensure dashboard order loading handles actor availability/config/auth errors gracefully (empty state vs explicit error) and does not crash the route render when backend connectivity is temporarily unavailable.

Ensure admin order listing handles authorization and backend connectivity errors gracefully, matching AdminGate expectations and avoiding unhandled exceptions that could bubble to the router error boundary. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Confirm admin gating displays access denied vs connectivity/config errors appropriately (delegating connectivity/config to BackendGate) and avoids throwing errors that would redirect to the generic router error page. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.
